problem.title: The problem isn't making more videos
problem.body: The problem is filming without knowing what works. Ads stop performing after two weeks, social media stops growing and the company video doesn't build trust. More videos won't fix it: videos made with a clear goal will.
problem.highlight: Every piece with a clear objective: attract, convince, or convert. Everything else is noise.

about.title: I was making UGC before most people in Spain knew what it was.
about.p1: I'm Pol Morera. I started when brands didn't even have a name for this yet. I was one of the first UGC creators in Spain, and the first male UGC creator.
about.p2: All these years taught me something you can't learn fast: what makes people stop scrolling, and what burns out in two weeks. That's what I bring to every video my team and I make for your brand.

svcpage.cta_text: I'll tell you which 3 videos your business needs.

ads.intro: I film videos where a real person talks about your product the way a customer would, made for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok ads. I write the script and film, and my team edits them with several different openings so you can see which one works best.

organic.h1: Videos for your business's social media
organic.intro: I plan the topics, then film and edit the videos with your logo and colours so you can post consistently without thinking every week about what to upload. I work with monthly packs.

corporate.intro: A video that explains what you do in a minute and makes a great impression. I write the script and film in 4K, and my team adds animated captions and prepares versions for your website, your sales team and your events.

aboutpage.name: Name
aboutpage.name_v: Pol Morera de Frutos (professionally, Pol Morera)
aboutpage.img_alt: Pol Morera, UGC creator in Barcelona
story: At first I filmed on my own. Today I work with my team: we write the script, film and edit, and deliver every video in the formats each channel needs.
Since then I've made over 1,000 videos for more than 300 brands, from big companies to local businesses. What I enjoy most is still the same: finding what makes someone stop scrolling.

how.d: Many brands come back. We've been working with Apple Tree for 31 months, with Dogfy Diet for two years and with Reactiva Online for 15 months.
You get the proposal within 2 working days and most projects are ready in 5–7. If it's urgent, we adapt.
I don't just show how a video looks, but what it achieves: like MasterD's 390 conversions on TikTok Ads or Dogfy Diet's leads, converting at 10–20%.
